thread.title: Community Calendar

author: Barbara Layton
title: Community Calendar
text:
Saturdays Through October
The Greene Center Farmers Market operates Saturdays from 8 a.m. to noon throughout the growing season, running through October at 10494 Charleston Road, Kenna, WV. Visitors can shop multiple vendors offering seasonal produce, jams and jellies, crafts, honey, eggs, meats, food trucks and special events. For more information, call 304-533-5920 or visit the Green Center Farmers Market Facebook page.
Tuesdays through Nov. 3
The Griefshare group will meet at Calvary United Methodist Church, located at 205 North Court Street, Ripley at 6:30 p.m., beginning Aug. 11, and each successive Tuesday through Nov. 3. For information, call 304-372-3203.
Aug. 29
Siniaville Community Church, located at 5454 Statts Mill Road, Ripley, is hosting a spaghetti dinner benefit for Lisa Skeen Rhodes from 12 p.m. to 4 p.m. Meals (dine-in or carry-out) are by donation. For information, contact Stacy Haunes at 304-532-0704.
Sept. 1
The Jackson County Democratic Women's Club will meet at 6 p.m. on Tuesday, Sept. 1 at First United Methodist Church, 719 Flinn Avenue in Ravenswood. The guest speaker will be Eli Baumwell, Director of ACLU-WV. Director Baumwell will address the erosion of civil liberties in the United States and West Virginia and what the ACLU is doing to protect those liberties. All Democrats and Independents are invited to attend this meeting.
Sept. 5
Hope House Ministries is sponsoring its annual Recover Out Loud event from 12 p.m. to 3 p.m. at Riverfront Park in Ravenswood. For information, call Jessica at 304-531-9678 or Jasmine at 681-369-9077.
Sept. 5
Independence United Methodist Church on Independence Road in Sandyville will be hosting a hot dog fundraiser from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m.
Sept. 5
The Baden Community Council will sponsor an old-fashioned ice cream social on Saturday, Sept. 5, 2026. The event will begin at 4 p.m. at the Baden Community Center, located on Route 87. Any donations of desserts will be appreciated. Homemade ice cream, hot dogs, sloppy joes, cakes, pies, soft drinks and coffee will be sold. Quart containers of ice cream will be sold as well, limited quantity. The public is encouraged to attend. Proceeds help pay the utilities and the upkeep of the building.
The community will be making the ice-cream at the Baden Community Center on Thursday, Sept. 3, 2026 at 4 p.m. All help appreciated.
Sept. 10
Community Resources Inc. and WVSU Healthy Grandfamilies are hosting a ‘Healthy Grandfamilies’ workshop at the Nazarene Legacy Center, located at 1109 Gallatin Street in Ravenswood, at 10 a.m. Snacks will be provided. For information, call 304-440-9171 or email tdunbar@cricap.org.
Sept. 12
The Cedar Lakes Foundation Bingo will begin at 1:30 p.m., with doors opening at 12 p.m. Early bird tickets are $20 (call 304-531-4578) or $25 at the door.
WIC
The Women, Infants, and Children (WIC) Nutrition Program is a supplemental food program for pregnant, post-partum, or breastfeeding women, infants, and children up to the age of five.
WIC provides food, breastfeeding support and nutrition education to families in Jackson County.
To apply for the WIC Program or to receive more information call our local office at 304-372-8525 or our main office in Parkersburg at 304-428-3688.
